parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        $1::uuid AS analysis_run_id,
        $2::jsonb AS search_terms_json,
        $3::text AS metadata_value,
        $4::jsonb AS existing_unit_ids_json
),

search_terms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        LOWER(TRIM(term.value)) AS term
    FROM params AS p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL
        jsonb_array_elements_text(p.search_terms_json) AS term(value)
    WHERE TRIM(term.value) <> ''

    UNION

    SELECT
        LOWER(TRIM(p.metadata_value))
    FROM params AS p
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(p.metadata_value), '') IS NOT NULL
),

base_units AS (
    SELECT
        u.id AS unit_db_id,
        u.analysis_run_id,
        u.document_id,
        u.analysis_unit_id,
        u.unit_index,
        u.units_total,

        u.section_id,
        u.section_title,
        u.section_kind,

        u.part_index,
        u.parts_total,

        u.source_pages,
        u.analysis_unit,
        u.ai_segments,
        u.provenance,

        d.document_index,
        d.file_name,
        d.file_extension,
        d.display_name,

        LOWER(
            CONCAT_WS(
                ' ',
                COALESCE(u.section_title, ''),
                COALESCE(u.analysis_unit::text, ''),
                COALESCE(u.ai_segments::text, '')
            )
        ) AS search_text,

        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM params AS p2
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL
                jsonb_array_elements_text(
                    p2.existing_unit_ids_json
                ) AS existing(unit_id)
            WHERE
                existing.unit_id =
                u.analysis_unit_id
        ) AS is_existing_candidate_unit

    FROM tender_analysis_units AS u

    JOIN tender_analysis_documents AS d
        ON d.id = u.document_id
       AND d.analysis_run_id = u.analysis_run_id

    JOIN params AS p
        ON p.analysis_run_id = u.analysis_run_id
),

scored_units AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
            FROM search_terms AS t
            WHERE
                b.search_text LIKE
                '%' || t.term || '%'
        ) AS term_hits,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT jsonb_agg(
                    t.term
                    ORDER BY t.term
                )
                FROM search_terms AS t
                WHERE
                    b.search_text LIKE
                    '%' || t.term || '%'
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS matched_terms

    FROM base_units AS b
),

ranked_units AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scored_units
    WHERE
        term_hits > 0
        OR is_existing_candidate_unit = true

    ORDER BY
        is_existing_candidate_unit DESC,
        term_hits DESC,
        document_index,
        unit_index

    LIMIT 10
),

context AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer AS context_units_count,

        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'analysis_unit_id',
                        r.analysis_unit_id,

                    'document_id',
                        r.document_id,

                    'document_index',
                        r.document_index,

                    'file_name',
                        r.file_name,

                    'file_extension',
                        r.file_extension,

                    'unit_index',
                        r.unit_index,

                    'section_id',
                        r.section_id,

                    'section_title',
                        r.section_title,

                    'section_kind',
                        r.section_kind,

                    'source_pages',
                        r.source_pages,

                    'is_existing_candidate_unit',
                        r.is_existing_candidate_unit,

                    'term_hits',
                        r.term_hits,

                    'matched_terms',
                        r.matched_terms,

                    'ai_segments',
                        r.ai_segments,

                    'analysis_unit',
                        r.analysis_unit,

                    'provenance',
                        r.provenance
                )
                ORDER BY
                    r.is_existing_candidate_unit DESC,
                    r.term_hits DESC,
                    r.document_index,
                    r.unit_index
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS context_units

    FROM ranked_units AS r
)

SELECT
    p.analysis_run_id,
    $5::text AS field_key,

    c.context_units_count,
    c.context_units

FROM params AS p
CROSS JOIN context AS c;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO tender_analysis_field_results (
    analysis_run_id,
    field_catalog_version,
    result_contract_version,
    field_index,
    field_key,
    status,
    value_text,
    confidence,
    requires_human_review,
    resolution_method,
    result_json
)
VALUES (
    $1::uuid,
    $2::text,
    $3::text,
    $4::smallint,
    $5::text,
    $6::text,
    $7::text,
    $8::numeric,
    $9::boolean,
    $10::text,
    $11::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (analysis_run_id, field_key)
DO UPDATE SET
    field_catalog_version = EXCLUDED.field_catalog_version,
    result_contract_version = EXCLUDED.result_contract_version,
    field_index = EXCLUDED.field_index,
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text,
    confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence,
    requires_human_review = EXCLUDED.requires_human_review,
    resolution_method = EXCLUDED.resolution_method,
    result_json = EXCLUDED.result_json,
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING
  analysis_run_id,
  field_key,
  field_index;
